verdict.rationale: The docs describe sandboxing to 'reduce blast radius' and a 'security audit' command, but nowhere document command allowlists, per-action approval prompts, or an opt-in elevated-privilege mode for dangerous actions. Community hands-on commentary directly contradicts any fine-grained approval gating, describing the security model as 'the equivalent of running as root - i.e. full access,' and a comparison to nanoclaw notes OpenClaw 'has almost exactly the same security risk surface' without such gating.
